levels.surface: محمد بن يحيى بن سعيد القطان

notes: first-person narrative: «فلقيت أنا» — Ibn Abi Attab is the narrator and the transmission is implicit (rule 11): the chain is read as written but needs a ruling
«فسألته عنه» names no one; «فقال عن أبيه» gives a bare relation
«قال مسلم يقول» is the compiler's own comment, not a link
